study_notes.observed: Former school ring: one-storey flat roofs about 3.85 m to the fascia top (Mar 2025 Street View panos aTtd, 4BjM, 6UrJ, gWJc, zHJe, nCSx; 2026 visitor photos of the patio). South tip e6-e8: Aracely Cafe, sage piers either side of a dark storefront, floral mural wall with bench planters, gravel patio with umbrellas, sloped pale fascia over a dark soffit. e9: white columns before wide frosted glazing. e11: three bays of blue spandrel, pale lights and dark clerestory, blue door. e13: projecting bay on white pilasters. e15: recess, then ribbon windows. e19-e21: dark brown posts and fascia over tan walls. e4: dark slate gym, its SSE and ENE fascias pale above the cafe roof.
study_notes.inferred: All dimensions and stations are production_inference from projected footprints on fitted panorama poses. Wall insets from eave shadows and pixel rays; column depth from foot offsets; gym depth (30 m) and roof-unit plans from the undated aerial; the cafe interior, script, mural and sign faces are original interpretations, not copies. North, far ENE, the NE lot side, the west wing outer face and the courtyard have no bound photo and keep their previous schemes; their roof edge only rises with the measured height.

study_notes.wholeunit_ends: The ends under the gym overhang differ on purpose, following sideD_240: at the NW end the photo shows a lower pale porch/hall under the fascia, so hall_nw fills the 1.25 m strip at hall height; at the SE end the photo shows an open dark pocket under the fascia (equipment, fence), so that strip stays open ground.
study_notes.reuse: Reuse (2026-11-06): stays on midrise_family with the l2fix-midrise-20261103 frontage reading adapted (columned walk, blue spandrels, bay, porch; e9 corrected to frosted glazing, its ribbon windows on unphotographed faces not taken). New opt-in family fields wall_ring, eaves, parts, lights, door glazing, fascia_edges and palette textures; other instances build as before.
study_notes.setting: The living-wall chain, heaters, furniture, hedge and beds are read off the Aug 2026 and Jan 2026 patio photos and the Mar 2025 panos; the shrub bands under the east wing and frontage run in the photos' order; furniture placing is production_inference. Palms in the beds are not drawn: the kit's palms are street trees, and agaves and flax carry the spiky form. The sidewalk beside the forecourt and the walks' ramps up its back slope are visual pads over the kerb's heights in the generated world; regenerate them if that kerb moves. The east lot's lawn pad holds the lawn recipe's dry patch off a lawn the photo shows green.
